meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.when: 当你要解析或检查 FCS 文件、提取事件为 NumPy 数组、读取通道和元数据时会用上;多数据集文件分离也适用。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can parse FCS 2.0–3.1 files, extract events into NumPy arrays, read metadata and channel info, and create FCS 3.1 files or export CSV.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to parse or inspect FCS files, extract events as NumPy arrays, read channel metadata, or split multi-dataset files.
